entries.title: A Claude crewmate's long build is no longer stopped while it waits its turn
entries.body: When a computer is busy, a crewmate's heavy build or check waits in line before it starts. On Claude, that wait counted against the run's time limit of at most 2 hours, so a run could be stopped before it began and lose its place in line. A Claude crewmate now starts such a run with a limit of up to 3 days.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes; the fix keeps a waiting run from being stopped.
